title: MetaKE: Meta-Learning for Knowledge Editing Toward a Better Accuracy-Editability Trade-off
abstract: arXiv:2603.12677v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Existing locate-then-edit Knowledge Editing (KE) methods typically decompose editing into two stages: upstream target representation optimization and downstream constrained parameter optimization. The optimization across the two stages is disconnected: upstream applies uniform regularization without observing downstream realization of the planned residual, hindering a refined accuracy-editability trade-off. Since this realization is request-specific and depends on downstream constraints, uniform regularization can over-shrink high-association requests, causing insufficient editing, while it can under-regularize low-association requests, producing over-large planned residuals that reduce downstream editability. To bridge this disconnect, we propose MetaKE (Meta-learning for Knowledge Editing), a new framework that unifies upstream and downstream stages into a bi-level optimization problem. translated_title: MetaKE：面向更优精度-可编辑性权衡的知识编辑元学习方法
translated_abstract: 现有基于“定位后编辑”的知识编辑方法通常将编辑分解为两个阶段：上游的目标表示优化和下游的受约束参数优化。两个阶段之间的优化是相互割裂的：上游在未能观察下游计划残差实际实现情况的前提下应用统一正则化，阻碍了精度与可编辑性之间的精细权衡。由于这种实现是请求特定的，并依赖于下游约束，统一正则化可能会过度收缩高关联请求，导致编辑不充分；同时可能对低关联请求正则化不足，产生过大的计划残差，从而降低下游的可编辑性。为弥合这一割裂，我们提出了MetaKE（面向知识编辑的元学习），一个将上游与下游阶段统一为双层优化问题的新框架。内层优化参数更新……
tldr: 提出MetaKE框架，通过元学习将知识编辑中上游表示优化与下游参数优化统一为双层优化问题，解决了两阶段优化割裂导致的编辑不充分或可编辑性下降问题，实现了精度与可编辑性之间更优的权衡。
en_tdlr: MetaKE is a meta-learning framework that unifies the disconnected upstream representation optimization and downstream parameter optimization stages of knowledge editing into a bi-level optimization problem, achieving a better accuracy-editability trade-off.
